name: bind_repo
description: Bind this workstream to a git repository and check out an isolated worktree for it. Every shell command and file tool in this workstream then runs inside that checkout. Call this before setup_env and dispatch_agent. ALWAYS pass the 'repo' argument — omitting it does NOT bind anything, it only reports the current binding and lists available repos.

repo.description: Name of a repo registered on this server. Pass this to actually bind. Omit ONLY when you want a read-only status report of the current binding and the available repos.

base_ref.description: Branch, tag or commit to check out from. Defaults to the repo's default branch.
